tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: ESTIMATE OF OPERATION & MAINTENANCE FOR FIVE YEARS OF MULTI VILLAGE WATER SUPPLY SCHEME TO URDIGERE & OTHER 02 VILLAGES OF TUMKUR TALUK IN TUMKUR DISTRICT

itemList.description: OPERATION AND MAINTAINANCE : for 1st Year : Operation and Maintenance of the Scheme as per TOR Which includes Providing Sufficient technical staff valve man, Operators, Electrician and Others who are required to run the system in Complete manner and providing all materials chemicals required for operation of Jack wells/WTP/Pipe line repair Works.1) Regular Maintenance of Civil Structures like Jack well come pump house Setting tank, Raw water storage tank, presure filter Pure water Sump, Pump house MBT and all Other Civil Structure. The Maintenance Consist of all kinds of repair to damaged structures cleaning & Washing All the infrastructure Must be Maintained in good working Condition through out the year so as to Ensure Unistarupted water supply to all the habitation through out the year & Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line valves etc. if found necessary in includes cost of materials and labour Charges and also monitoring of the systems the Maintenance involves raw water Rising main, Gravity Mains, pure water rising mains, maintaining the required discharge the quantum at water in each pipe. 2) Operation and Maintenance of Water Treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of Alum, Chlorine and Other required necessary chemicals including replacement of sand/filter media as required as per standard of Established norms from time to time. Maintenance the quality of water as per the guidelines CPHEEO Manual and ISI Specifications including cost of testing of water @ laboratory twice in a month. 3) Operation and Maintenance of all Kinds of Pumping Machinery Other Mechanical Component of this scheme including Electrical Maintenance Covering all repairs/ Replacement of Electrical Cable/ Switch  Board/ Replacement of burnt parts of Machinery all the Above repair & Maintenance will be carried out as per the Direction of the Engineer-in Charges for Satisfactory functioning of the Scheme to Provide designed discharge for Drinking water to all the habitations of the Project Villages. Note : Helpers/Watchman/Valve man/Electrician/Technical Staff made available round the clock for Maintenance period @ Jack well, WTP, and pure water sump points. (1) The G.P or VWSC/ Concerned Section officer of the Project Should Certify the Satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payment will be made to the Contractor (2) The Contractor Should Maintain a Log Book on the Working of pumping Machinery @ jack well, WTP etc. the Payment will be made by the Engineer-in Charges for Satisfactory report of every month end (The GP Secretary and So In change Of presure filter Should give Satisfactory report) subject to Conduction appended in TOR etc., complete with all lead and lift loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer in-charge of the work.(Excluding energy charges) Note:-Contractor should execute the work as per the technical sanctioned estimate Quantities like Establishment,Consumables,Transportation,and communication, Office accommodation,Stationery charges, etc., which is attached separately.
